checkpoint: Minimum selection sparse cross-entropy, including epoch zero; joint restore of classifier and gate
primary_metric: accuracy; paired task-minus-raw differences in percentage points
scope: Prespecified additional training seeds45/46/47 on the same explored FordA TRAIN split; training randomness replication, not an independent dataset confirmation.
fixed_ssa_rule: Per-sample smallest prefix explaining >=90% trajectory singular-value squared energy. No labels or held-out tuning.
scale: One scalar mean/std fitted on fit input values only; applied to all raw samples before SSA. No separate output normalization.
budget: Each seed has one fresh common pretraining (max40epochs, original patience10), then three matched60epoch branches with2400classifierupdates; taskheads have2400extra updates. Same batch order and initialization per seed.
stop_rule: Finish all3newseeds and3variants before assessment scoring; report new3 separately and all6. No changes to RMSfloor0.001, architecture, split, LR or epoch budget; official TEST unopened.
normalization_rule: Each selector component divided by max(RMS,0.001), no centering. Floor fixed engineering choice in standardized raw units; limits amplification to1000; numerical residual stays near zero. Does not normalize reconstruction or downstream classifier input.
comparison: New45/46/47 paired task_normalized-minus-raw primary; normalized-minus-unnormalized secondary. Old42/43/44 retained in all6summary, never overwrite old results.
